notes.title: Notice of change in release date for “SHINONOME ABYSS The Maiden Exorcist”
notes.content:
[b]Due to various circumstances, the release date for the strategy roguelike horror action game“SHINONOME ABYSS The Maiden Exorcist” has been changed to 2025. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to those who have been looking forward to its release. We hope you will be patient with us for a little while longer.[/b]
